_note: v2.5 plan 09 SP5 story-owned scenario SPIKE, the live measurement of C1-C5 (docs/plans/v2.5/09-research-spikes.md SP5; report docs/plans/v2.5/09-sp5-spike-report.md). DEV build only (the spike is a __SO_DEV__ dynamic import, `npm run build:dev && npm run serve:dev`), LANES ONLY: it switches the install-wide flag extensionSettings['story-orchestrator'].settings.spikes.sp5Scenario on and back, and plants card scenarios IN MEMORY on Arin, Luke, Ponticius and DM Narrator (never saved; put back by the last steps, and a reload drops them anyway). Run it ×2 back to back: `node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts batch --lanes <n> --repeat 2 --strict --group 1759606632088 test/scenarios/live-v25-09-sp5-scenario.json` with a run header captured before and diffed after. No model is needed: the request is ST's own dry-run assembly (GENERATE_AFTER_COMBINE_PROMPTS script.js:5242, or CHAT_COMPLETION_PROMPT_READY openai.js:1618-1619), and C3's two extraction reads use debugResponse, because what is measured is the host effect, not the read. Chats: A = the sandbox group chat (C3, then parked at hall = cp3; C4), B = a new solo Arin chat at gate (cp1), C = a new solo Luke chat with no story. The expected scenario is recomputed by test/fixtures/interop/v25-09-sp5.js from the AUTHORED story (getPlayedStoryRaw) and the engine's visitedPath, not by src/runtime. The record is kept in localStorage `so-v25-sp5` and printed by the last step. After a FAILED run: remove spikes.sp5Scenario by hand, reload the page (drops the planted scenarios), `so-library.mts remove "SO-SP5 Scenario"` and `"SO-SP5 No Scenario"`, and diff the run header.

steps.eval: const S = globalThis.__soSp5; if (!S) throw new Error('the v25-09-sp5 helper is not injected'); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (!ctx.groupId) throw new Error('needs a sandbox GROUP chat (it is chat A)'); localStorage.removeItem(S.KEY); const flag = await S.flag(true); const planted = S.plant(); if (planted.length < 3) throw new Error(`fewer than three cards to plant a scenario on: ${JSON.stringify(planted)}`); const T = S.load(); T.chats = { A: S.here() }; S.save(T); return { flag, planted, chats: T.chats };

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); const T = S.load(); T.story = rt.getPlayedStoryRaw(); S.save(T); const rows = S.rows(); const held = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata?.scenario ?? ''; if (!rows.length) throw new Error('no scenario ledger row after the import: the SP5 spike is not registered (a prod bundle?) or its flag did not take'); if (held !== S.expected(T.story, ['gate'])) throw new Error(`the gate did not write its scenario: ${JSON.stringify(held)}`); return { rows: rows.map((row) => row.status), held };

steps.send: We walk out through the city gate onto the road.

steps.eval: const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const T = S.load(); T.evidence1 = ctx.chat.length - 1; if (!ctx.chat[T.evidence1]?.is_user) throw new Error('the last message is not the player line just sent'); S.save(T); return { evidence1: T.evidence1 };

extract.debugResponse: DELTA q=left_gate value=true evidence="walk out through the city gate"

steps.eval: const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const T = S.load(); const held = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata?.scenario ?? ''; const rows = S.rows(); if (held !== S.expected(T.story, ['gate', 'road'])) throw new Error(`the road should keep the gate's scenario: ${JSON.stringify(held)}`); if (rows.length !== 1) throw new Error(`the road authors no scenario, so it must not write one: ${JSON.stringify(rows.map((row) => row.status))}`); return { held, rows: rows.length };

steps.send: We push open the guild hall doors and step inside.

steps.eval: const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const T = S.load(); T.evidence2 = ctx.chat.length - 1; if (!ctx.chat[T.evidence2]?.is_user) throw new Error('the last message is not the player line just sent'); S.save(T); return { evidence2: T.evidence2 };

steps.slash: /sendas name=Luke raw=false "It is warm in here."

steps.eval: const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const T = S.load(); const held = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata?.scenario ?? ''; const three = S.expected(T.story, ['gate', 'road', 'hall']); const prompt = await S.capture(); const statuses = S.rows().map((row) => row.status); if (held !== three) throw new Error(`the hall did not write its scenario: ${JSON.stringify(held)}`); if (S.count(prompt, three) !== 1) throw new Error(`the hall's scenario is in the request ${S.count(prompt, three)} time(s)`); T.C3 = { before: { held, statuses } }; S.save(T); return T.C3;

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const T = S.load(); const id = T.evidence2; const message = ctx.chat[id]; const text = 'We stay out on the road and argue about the map.'; message.mes = text; if (Array.isArray(message.swipes) && Number.isInteger(message.swipe_id)) message.swipes[message.swipe_id] = text; await ctx.updateMessageBlock?.(id, message); await ctx.saveChat?.(); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_EDITED, id); return { edited: id };

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const T = S.load(); for (let index = 0; index < 40 && !rt.getSnapshot().lastRollback; index += 1) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); await S.settle(); const held = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata?.scenario ?? ''; const one = S.expected(T.story, ['gate', 'road']); const three = S.expected(T.story, ['gate', 'road', 'hall']); const rows = S.rows(); const hall = rows.find((row) => row.after?.text === three); const prompt = await S.capture(); T.C3.after = { held, statuses: rows.map((row) => row.status), hallRow: hall?.status ?? null, oneInRequest: S.count(prompt, one), threeInRequest: S.count(prompt, three), rolledBack: Boolean(rt.getSnapshot().lastRollback) }; T.C3.pass = held === one && hall?.status === 'reverted' && T.C3.after.oneInRequest === 1 && T.C3.after.threeInRequest === 0; S.save(T); if (!T.C3.pass) throw new Error(`C3: ${JSON.stringify(T.C3)}`); return T.C3;

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const T = S.load(); await S.settle(); const three = S.expected(T.story, globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getEngineState().visitedPath); if ((ctx.chatMetadata?.scenario ?? '') !== three) throw new Error(`chat A should sit at the hall's scenario: ${JSON.stringify(ctx.chatMetadata?.scenario)}`); const group = ctx.groups.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === String(ctx.groupId)); const enabled = group.members.filter((member) => !(group.disabled_members ?? []).includes(member)).map((avatar) => ctx.characters.find((card) => card.avatar === avatar)?.name).filter(Boolean); const cards = enabled.filter((name) => Object.keys(T.planted ?? {}).includes(name)).map(S.cardText); const texts = [...new Set(cards)]; const mode = group.generation_mode; group.generation_mode = 1; let withOverride; let control; try { const prompt = await S.capture(); withOverride = { scenario: S.count(prompt, three), cards: texts.map((text) => S.count(prompt, text)) }; const saved = ctx.chatMetadata.scenario; ctx.chatMetadata.scenario = ''; try { const bare = await S.capture(); control = { scenario: S.count(bare, three), cards: texts.map((text) => S.count(bare, text)) }; } finally { ctx.chatMetadata.scenario = saved; } } finally { group.generation_mode = mode; } T.C4 = { members: enabled.length, planted: cards.length, withOverride, control, pass: cards.length >= 3 && withOverride.scenario === 1 && withOverride.cards.every((hits) => hits === 0) && control.cards.every((hits, index) => hits === cards.filter((text) => text === texts[index]).length) }; S.save(T); if (!T.C4.pass) throw new Error(`C4: ${JSON.stringify(T.C4)}`); return T.C4;

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const T = S.load(); await rt.selectStory('so-v25-sp5'); await S.settle(); T.chats.B = S.here(); S.save(T); const held = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata?.scenario ?? ''; if (held !== S.expected(T.story, ['gate'])) throw new Error(`chat B should hold the gate's scenario: ${JSON.stringify(held)}`); return { B: T.chats.B, held };

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const T = S.load(); if (globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().storyId) throw new Error('chat C must play no story'); T.chats.C = S.here(); S.save(T); return { C: T.chats.C };

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const T = S.load(); const legs = [['A', 'so-v25-sp5'], ['B', 'so-v25-sp5'], ['C', null]]; const results = []; for (let round = 1; round <= 3; round += 1) { for (const [label, storyId] of legs) { await S.goto(T.chats[label], storyId); const check = await S.check(`${label}${round}`, T.story, storyId); const prompt = await S.capture(); check.card = label === 'B' ? S.count(prompt, S.cardText('Arin')) : label === 'C' ? S.count(prompt, S.cardText('Luke')) : null; if (label === 'B' && check.card !== 0) check.fail.push('B: the card scenario reached a chat whose story sets one'); if (label === 'C' && check.card !== 1) check.fail.push('C: the no-story chat lost its own card scenario'); results.push(check); } } await S.goto(T.chats.A, 'so-v25-sp5'); results.push(await S.check('A-final', T.story, 'so-v25-sp5')); T.C1 = { captures: results.length, failed: results.filter((check) => check.fail.length).length, results }; T.C1.pass = T.C1.failed === 0 && results.length === 10; S.save(T); if (!T.C1.pass) throw new Error(`C1: ${JSON.stringify(results.filter((check) => check.fail.length))}`); return { captures: T.C1.captures, failed: T.C1.failed, wants: results.map((check) => `${check.label}:${check.want ? 'story' : 'none'}`) };

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = () => SillyTavern.getContext(); const T = S.load(); const USER = 'SO-SP5 user override B: a quiet night at the inn.'; await S.goto(T.chats.B, 'so-v25-sp5'); ctx().chatMetadata.scenario = USER; await ctx().saveMetadata(); await rt.activateCheckpoint('hall'); await S.settle(); const newest = S.rows().at(-1); const prompt = await S.capture(); const three = S.expected(T.story, ['gate', 'road', 'hall']); const first = { held: ctx().chatMetadata?.scenario ?? '', newest: newest ? { status: newest.status, found: newest.found ?? null, after: newest.after } : null, userInRequest: S.count(prompt, USER), threeInRequest: S.count(prompt, three) }; await S.goto(T.chats.C, null); await S.goto(T.chats.B, 'so-v25-sp5'); const back = { held: ctx().chatMetadata?.scenario ?? '', refusedRows: S.rows().filter((row) => row.status === 'externally-changed').length }; T.C2 = { order1: { first, back, pass: first.held === USER && first.newest?.status === 'externally-changed' && first.newest?.found?.text === USER && first.userInRequest === 1 && first.threeInRequest === 0 && back.held === USER && back.refusedRows === 1 } }; S.save(T); if (!T.C2.order1.pass) throw new Error(`C2 order 1: ${JSON.stringify(T.C2.order1)}`); return T.C2.order1;

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = () => SillyTavern.getContext(); const T = S.load(); const USER = 'SO-SP5 user override A: the party is snowed in.'; await S.goto(T.chats.A, 'so-v25-sp5'); const own = ctx().chatMetadata?.scenario ?? ''; ctx().chatMetadata.scenario = USER; await ctx().saveMetadata(); await S.goto(T.chats.C, null); await S.goto(T.chats.A, 'so-v25-sp5'); const afterLeave = ctx().chatMetadata?.scenario ?? ''; await rt.restartStory(true); await S.settle(); const afterRestart = ctx().chatMetadata?.scenario ?? ''; const statuses = S.rows().map((row) => row.status); const prompt = await S.capture(); T.C2.order2 = { own, afterLeave, afterRestart, statuses, userInRequest: S.count(prompt, USER) }; T.C2.order2.pass = afterLeave === USER && afterRestart === USER && statuses.includes('externally-changed') && T.C2.order2.userInRequest === 1; T.C2.pass = T.C2.order1.pass && T.C2.order2.pass; S.save(T); if (!T.C2.order2.pass) throw new Error(`C2 order 2: ${JSON.stringify(T.C2.order2)}`); return T.C2.order2;

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const ctx = () => SillyTavern.getContext(); const T = S.load(); await S.goto(T.chats.A, 'so-v25-sp5'); ctx().chatMetadata.scenario = ''; await ctx().saveMetadata(); T.c5before = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => /character card scenario\(s\) frame this chat/.test(event.summary)).length; S.save(T); return { cleared: true, before: T.c5before };

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const T = S.load(); const find = () => rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => /character card scenario\(s\) frame this chat/.test(event.summary)).map((event) => ({ summary: event.summary, note: event.detail?.note ?? '' })); await S.settle(); const group = find().slice(T.c5before); await S.goto(T.chats.C, null); const beforeC = find().length; await rt.selectStory('so-v25-sp5-none'); await S.settle(); const solo = find().slice(beforeC); const names = (entry) => (entry?.note ?? '').split(', ').filter(Boolean).sort(); T.C5 = { group: group.map(names), solo: solo.map(names) }; T.C5.pass = group.length === 1 && names(group[0]).length >= 3 && solo.length === 1 && names(solo[0]).join() === 'Luke'; S.save(T); if (!T.C5.pass) throw new Error(`C5: ${JSON.stringify(T.C5)}`); return T.C5;

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const T = S.load(); T.C5.playerClean = true; S.save(T); const text = document.querySelector('#drawer-manager')?.textContent ?? ''; if (/card scenario/i.test(text)) throw new Error('the competing-cards diagnostic reached the player drawer'); return { playerDrawerMentionsIt: false };

const S = globalThis.__soSp5; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const unplanted = S.unplant(); const flag = await S.flag(false); await rt.removeStory('so-v25-sp5').catch(() => null); await rt.removeStory('so-v25-sp5-none').catch(() => null); const T = S.load(); const verdict = { C1: T.C1?.pass ?? null, C2: T.C2?.pass ?? null, C3: T.C3?.pass ?? null, C4: T.C4?.pass ?? null, C5: (T.C5?.pass && T.C5?.playerClean) ?? null }; return { verdict, unplanted, flag, record: T };
